    """Bind a read completion to exact output ranges if its console echo lost bytes.

    hex sample, frozen identity and whole-stream CRC. No mutating command can
    use this path, and a prompt/result alone cannot acknowledge a request.

+body='\n'.join(x for x in d.splitlines() if x.startswith('K7DISPLAY '));assert len(body.splitlines())==15
+p=F/'display-stopped-body.txt';p.write_text(body,encoding='utf8')
+(P/'stop.request').write_text('ROOT closes F20 owner after joined stop, preparing accepted r22 persistent deployment backups',encoding='utf8')
+print(json.dumps({'camera_display_joined':True,'display_sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'accepted_prefix_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'owner_stop_requested':True,'storage_written':False}))
*** End Patch"));
